noticias.titular: Let’s keep virtual reality headsets for tasks where the point of view matters
noticias.entradilla: To draw a cove, a map may be enough. To work out at which bend in the path the lighthouse drops out of sight, it does make sense to step into the landscape.

noticias.titular: Grading a text prepared with AI requires a sample of the student’s own writing
noticias.entradilla: Asking students to explain how they used artificial intelligence makes sense if they know the rules before they start. Giving a mark takes something more, even when the declaration is entirely sincere.
